# E0122: the lineage declares no schemas

A lineage declares at least one schema, version 0.0. This one declares none.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0122]: the lineage declares no schemas
 --> lineage.cue:2:1
  |
2 | schemas: {}
  | ^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: declare at least version 0.0 under schemas
```
